title: The MF property for amalgamated free products
summary: A C*-algebra (or a group) is called MF (matricial field) if it admits finite dimensional approximate unitary representations which are approximately injective, where approximately is meant with respect to the operator norm. It is proved that for any MF C*-algebra $A$ and its C*-subalgebra $C$, $A\ast_C A$ is MF. For general amalgamated free products, $A\ast_C B$, a necessary and sufficient condition for being MF is given.
